SQLite is the live database — all reads and writes go through it. `issues.jsonl` is a git-synced artifact exported on demand: one entry per bead, committed to the repo for backup, sharing, and recovery. Concurrent claiming is handled by SQLite's `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction — no server, no daemon, no flock required.\n\n## Core Principles\n\n1. **SQLite is the live store** — all mutations are SQL writes; reads are SQL queries. Fast, concurrent-read, serialized-write via WAL mode.\n2. **JSONL is the git artifact** — exported on `bf sync`, committed to git, one entry per bead. Used for backup, cross-machine sharing, and recovery. Never written during normal operation.\n3. **Drop-in CLI** — all `br` commands work under `bf` with the same flags and output formats\n4. **`BEGIN IMMEDIATE` for atomic claim** — the read-score-update sequence runs inside a single SQLite write transaction, eliminating the race condition `br` has without requiring flock or a daemon\n\n---\n\n## Phase 1: Core Library — Data Model & JSONL Import/Export\n\n### 1.1 Data Model (`src/model.rs`)\n\nPort the exact `Issue`, `Status`, `Priority`, `IssueType`, `Dependency`, `DependencyType`, `Comment`, and `Event` structs from beads_rust with identical Serde attributes. This is the wire format — every field, every `skip_serializing_if`, every rename must match.\n\nKey structs and their JSONL serialization:\n\n```\nStatus:       open | in_progress | blocked | deferred | draft | closed | tombstone | pinned | Custom(String)\nPriority:     transparent i32 (0=Critical, 4=Backlog)\nIssueType:    task | bug | feature | epic | chore | docs | question | Custom(String)\nDependency:   { issue_id, depends_on_id, type (renamed from dep_type), created_at, created_by?, metadata?, thread_id? }\nComment:      { id: i64, issue_id, author, text (renamed from body), created_at }\nEvent:        { id: i64, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value?, new_value?, comment?, created_at }\n```\n\nIssue fields (alphabetical by JSON key):\n```\nid, title, description?, design?, acceptance_criteria?, notes?,\nstatus, priority, issue_type, assignee?, owner?, estimated_minutes?,\ncreated_at, created_by?, updated_at, closed_at?, close_reason?,\nclosed_by_session?, due_at?, defer_until?, external_ref?,\nsource_system?, source_repo, deleted_at?, deleted_by?, delete_reason?,\noriginal_type?, compaction_level (default 0), compacted_at?,\ncompacted_at_commit?, original_size?, sender?, ephemeral (default false),\npinned (default false), is_template (default false),\nlabels: Vec<String>, dependencies: Vec<Dependency>, comments: Vec<Comment>\n```\n\n### 1.2 JSONL Import (`src/jsonl.rs`)\n\nJSONL is read only during `bf sync --import` (pulling state from git) and `bf doctor --repair` (rebuilding SQLite from the artifact). Never read during normal CLI operation.\n\n```rust\nfn import_jsonl(jsonl_path: &Path, storage: &Storage) -> Result<ImportResult> {\n    let file = File::open(jsonl_path)?;\n    let reader = BufReader::new(file);\n    storage.with_write_transaction(|tx| {\n        for line in reader.lines() {\n            let issue: Issue = serde_json::from_str(&line?)?;\n            tx.upsert_issue(&issue)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    })\n}\n```\n\nFunctions:\n- `import_jsonl(path, storage)` — bulk upsert from JSONL into SQLite\n- `stream_issues(path) -> impl Iterator<Item = Result<Issue>>` — lazy line iterator (used by import and doctor)\n\n### 1.3 JSONL Export (`src/jsonl.rs`)\n\nJSONL is written only during `bf sync --flush` (preparing the git artifact). Exports current bead state from SQLite, one entry per bead, sorted by ID for stable diffs. Atomic temp+rename.\n\n```rust\nfn export_jsonl(jsonl_path: &Path, storage: &Storage) -> Result<ExportResult> {\n    let issues = storage.list_all_issues()?;  // sorted by ID\n    let temp_path = jsonl_path.with_extension(\"jsonl.tmp\");\n    let mut writer = BufWriter::new(File::create_new(&temp_path)?);\n    for issue in &issues {\n        serde_json::to_writer(&mut writer, issue)?;\n        writer.write_all(b\"\\n\")?;\n    }\n    writer.flush()?;\n    drop(writer);\n    fs::rename(&temp_path, jsonl_path)?;\n    Ok(ExportResult { count: issues.len() })\n}\n```\n\nFunctions:\n- `export_jsonl(path, storage)` — dump all beads from SQLite to JSONL (atomic)\n- `export_jsonl_dirty(path, storage)` — export only dirty beads (incremental, faster for large workspaces)\n\n### 1.4 Config (`src/config.rs`)\n\nParse `.beads/config.yaml` with the same fields br uses:\n\n```yaml\nissue_prefixes: [bd, fg]\ndefault_priority: 2","numLines":100,"startLine":1,"totalLines":1574}}}

2.0\n485\t                 + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)\n486\t             ) / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n487\t                 downstream_impact DESC,\n488\t                 critical_path_bonus DESC,\n489\t                 i.priority ASC,\n490\t                 i.created_at ASC\n491\t             LIMIT ?3\"\n492\t        };\n493\t        tx.prepare(sql)?\n494\t    } else {\n495\t        // Standard scoring without velocity data\n496\t        let sql = if unlimited {\n497\t            \"SELECT i.id, i.title, i.status, i.priority,\n498\t                    COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n499\t                    1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1) as critical_path_bonus,\n500\t                    i.created_at\n501\t             FROM issues i\n502\t             LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n503\t             LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n504\t             WHERE i.status = 'open'\n505\t               AND i.ephemeral = 0\n506\t               AND i.pinned = 0\n507\t               AND JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n512\t                   WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n513\t                   AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n514\t                   AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n515\t               )\n516\t             GROUP BY i.id\n517\t             ORDER BY\n518\t                 downstream_impact DESC,\n519\t                 critical_path_bonus DESC,\n520\t                 i.priority ASC,\n521\t                 i.created_at ASC\"\n522\t        } else {\n523\t            \"SELECT i.id, i.title, i.status, i.priority,\n524\t                    COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n525\t                    1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1) as critical_path_bonus,\n526\t                    i.created_at\n527\t             FROM issues i\n528\t             LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n529\t             LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n530\t             WHERE i.status = 'open'\n531\t               AND i.ephemeral = 0\n532\t               AND i.pinned = 0\n533\t               AND i.is_template = 0\n534\t               AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n535\t               AND NOT EXISTS (\n536\t                   SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n537\t                   INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n538\t                   WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n539\t                   AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n540\t                   AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n541\t               )\n542\t             GROUP BY i.id\n543\t             ORDER BY\n544\t                 downstream_impact DESC,\n545\t                 critical_path_bonus DESC,\n546\t                 i.priority ASC,\n547\t                 i.created_at ASC\n548\t             LIMIT ?1\"\n549\t        };\n550\t        tx.prepare(sql)?\n551\t    };\n552\t\n553\t    let mut rows = if model.is_some() && harness.is_some() {\n554\t        if unlimited {\n555\t            stmt.query(params![model.unwrap(), harness.unwrap()])?\n556\t        } else {\n557\t            stmt.query(params![model.unwrap(), harness.unwrap(), limit as i64])?\n558\t        }\n559\t    } else {\n560\t        if unlimited {\n561\t            stmt.query([])?\n562\t        } else {\n563\t            stmt.query(params![limit as i64])?\n564\t        }\n565\t    };\n566\t\n567\t    let mut candidates = Vec::new();\n568\t\n569\t    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n570\t        candidates.push(ScoredBead {\n571\t            id: row.get(0)?,\n572\t            title: row.get(1)?,\n573\t            status: row.get(2)?,\n574\t            priority: row.get(3)?,\n575\t            downstream_impact: row.get(4)?,\n576\t            critical_float: row.get(5)?,\n577\t            created_at: row.get(6)?,\n578\t        });\n579\t    }\n580\t\n581\t    Ok(candidates)\n582\t}\n583\t\n584\t/// Claim from the highest-priority bead across multiple workspaces.\n585\t///\n586\t/// Scores each workspace's top candidate, picks the global winner,\n587\t/// and claims from that workspace.\n588\t///\n589\t/// # Arguments\n590\t/// * `workspace_paths` - Slice of workspace directory paths\n591\t/// * `worker` - The worker ID claiming the bead\n592\t/// * `claim_ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes after which in_progress beads are reclaimed\n593\t/// * `worker_metadata` - Optional worker metadata (model, harness, version)\n594\t///\n595\t/// # Returns\n596\t/// * `Ok(Some(claim_result))` - A bead was claimed (with workspace_path set)\n597\t/// * `Ok(None)` - No beads available to claim in any workspace\n598\t/// * `Err(e)` - Transaction error\n599\tpub fn claim_any(\n600\t    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n601\t    worker: &str,\n602\t    claim_ttl_minutes: i64,\n603\t    worker_metadata: Option<&WorkerMetadata>,\n604\t) -> Result<Option<ClaimResult>> {\n605\t    use crate::config::load_metadata;\n606\t    use crate::storage::Storage;\n607\t\n608\t    // Extract model and harness for velocity-aware scoring\n609\t    let (model, harness) = if let Some(meta) = worker_metadata {\n610\t        (meta.model.as_deref(), meta.harness.as_deref())\n611\t    } else {\n612\t        (None, None)\n613\t    };\n614\t\n615\t    // Score across all workspaces\n616\t    let mut best: Option<(Score, usize)> = None;\n617\t    for (idx, workspace_path) in workspace_paths.iter().enumerate() {\n618\t        let beads_dir = get_beads_dir(workspace_path)?;\n619\t        let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n620\t        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n621\t\n622\t        // Open each workspace's SQLite\n623\t        match Storage::open(&db_path) {\n624\t            Ok(storage) => {\n625\t                if let Some(score) = storage.top_candidate_score(model, harness)? {\n626\t                    if best.as_ref().map(|(b, _)| score > *b).unwrap_or(true) {\n627\t                        best = Some((score, idx));\n628\t                    }\n629\t                }\n630\t            }\n631\t            Err(_) => {\n632\t                // Skip workspaces that can't be opened (e.g., no .beads directory)\n633\t                continue;\n634\t            }\n635\t        }\n636\t    }\n637\t\n638\t    match best {\n639\t        None => Ok(None),\n640\t        Some((_, workspace_idx)) => {\n641\t            let workspace_path = &workspace_paths[workspace_idx];\n642\t            let beads_dir = get_beads_dir(workspace_path)?;\n643\t            let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n644\t            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n645\t            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n646\t\n647\t            let now = Utc::now();\n648\t            match storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n649\t                claim(tx, worker, claim_ttl_minutes, now, worker_metadata)\n650\t            })? {\n651\t                Some(mut result) => {\n652\t                    result.workspace_path = Some(workspace_path.clone());\n653\t                    Ok(Some(result))\n654\t                }\n655\t                None => Ok(None),\n656\t            }\n657\t        }\n658\t    }\n659\t}\n660\t\n661\t/// Get the .beads directory from a workspace path.\n662\t///\n663\t/// If the workspace path itself contains a .beads directory, use it.\n664\t/// Otherwise, assume the path IS the .beads directory.\n665\tfn get_beads_dir(workspace_path: &Path) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf> {\n666\t    let beads_dir = workspace_path.join(\".beads\");\n667\t    if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n668\t        Ok(beads_dir)\n669\t    } else if workspace_path.ends_with(\".beads\") {\n670\t        Ok(workspace_path.to_path_buf())\n671\t    } else {\n672\t        use anyhow::bail;\n673\t        bail!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace_path)\n674\t    }\n675\t}\n676\t\n677\t/// Find all bead workspace directories starting from a search path.\n678\t///\n679\t/// Searches for directories containing a .beads subdirectory.\n680\t/// Searches upward from the start path through parent directories.\n681\tpub fn find_workspaces(start_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {\n682\t    let mut workspaces = Vec::new();\n683\t\n684\t    // Start from the given path and search upward\n685\t    let mut current = start_path.to_path_buf();\n686\t    loop {\n687\t        let beads_dir = current.join(\".beads\");\n688\t        if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n689\t            // Found a workspace - add the parent directory\n690\t            workspaces.push(current.clone());\n691\t        }\n692\t\n693\t        // Move to parent directory\n694\t        if !current.pop() {\n695\t            // Reached the root, stop searching\n696\t            break;\n697\t        }\n698\t    }\n699\t\n700\t    Ok(workspaces)\n701\t}\n702\t\n703\t#[cfg(test)]\n704\tmod tests {\n705\t    use super::*;\n706\t fn test_critical_path_bonus_in_claim() {\n        use crate::storage::schema;\n\n        let (_temp, mut storage) = setup_test_db();\n\n        // Create a dependency chain: bf-critical (float=0) -> bf-blocked\n        // And an independent bead: bf-independent (no critical path data)\n\n        let critical = Issue::new(\n            \"bf-critical\".to_string(),\n            \"Critical path \"bf-independent\".to_string(),\n            \"Independent bead\".to_string(),\n            \".\".to_string(),\n        );\n        storage.create_issue(&independent).unwrap();\n\n        // Add &crate::model::DependencyType::Blocks,\n                \"test\",\n            )\n            .unwrap();\n\n        // Manually populate critical_path_cache\n        // (create_issue already calls params![\n                        \"bf-critical\",\n                        \"bf-critical\",\n                        0i64,  // es\n                        0i64,  // ls\n                        0i64,  // float = ls - es = 0\n                        Utc::now().to_rfc3339()\n                    ],\n                )?;\n\n                // bf-blocked has float=1 (not on critical path)\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO critical_path_cache (bead_id, epic_id, es, ls, float, updated_at)\n                     VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)\",\n                    params![\n                        \"bf-blocked\",\n                        \"bf-critical\",\n                        1i64,  // es\n                        2i64,  // ls\n                        1i64,  // float = ls - es = 1\n                        Utc::now().to_rfc3339()\n                    ],\n                )?;\n\n                // bf-independent has no entry in critical_path_cache\n                Ok(())\n            })\n            .unwrap();\n\n        // Get ready candidates - should be ordered by critical path bonus\n        let candidates = storage\n            .with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 10, None, None))\n            .unwrap();\n\n        // bf-critical should be first (bonus=1000.0/1=1000)\n        // bf-independent should be second (bonus=1000.0/1000=1)\n        // bf-blocked is NOT in the list because it's blocked by bf-critical\n        assert_eq!(candidates.len(), 2);\n        assert_eq!(candidates[0].id, \"bf-critical\");\n        assert_eq!(candidates[1].id, \"bf-independent\");\n\n        // Verify bonus values\n        // critical_float stores the BONUS value, not the raw float\n        assert!((candidates[0].critical_float - 1000.0).abs() < 0.01); // float=0 → bonus=1000\n        assert!((candidates[1].critical_float - 1.0).abs() < 0.01); // no cache → bonus≈1\n    }\n\n ),\n    }\n}\n\nfn cmd_init(beads_dir: &PathBuf, prefix: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(beads_dir)?;\n\n    let config_path = beads_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if    std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = beads_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        let metadata = r#\"{\"database\": String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n \".\".to_string());\n    issue.issue_type = IssueType::from_str(type_.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n    issue.priority = Priority(priority);\n    issue.description = description;\n Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir, id)?\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id))?\n        }\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n            // format ({id, title, status, priority, dependency_type}) differs from\n            // bead-forge's Dependency format ({issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}).\n            // NEEDLE has #[serde(default)] on the deps field so empty is fine.\n            let mut out = issue;\n            out.dependencies = vec![];\n            out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: cmd_ready(beads_dir: &PathBuf, limit: usize, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // --limit 0 means unlimited (get_ready_candidates omits LIMIT clause when limit == 0)\n    let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, limit, None, None))?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Output as JSON array: [] for empty, [candidate] for single, [c1, c2, ...] for multiple\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidates)?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        candidate.critical_float,\n                    )\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"[{}] {} (priority={}, impact={}, float={})\",\n                    candidate.id,\n                    candidate.title,\n                    candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback == Some(\"any\")\n        {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path = local_beads_dir.join(&local_metadata.database);\n                    if let Ok(local_storage) = Storage::open(&local_db_path) {\n                        if let Ok(local_candidates) = local_storage\n                            .with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))\n                        {\n                            for c in local_candidates {\n                                all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Sort by score and take top 1\n            all_candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n                let score_a = (b.1.downstream_impact, b.1.priority, b.1.created_at.clone());\n                let score_b = (a.1.downstream_impact, a.1.priority, a.1.created_at.clone());\n                score_a.cmp(&score_b)\n            });\n            all_candidates.into_iter().take(1).collect()\n        } else {\n            // Single workspace dry run\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let candidates =\n                storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))?;\n            candidates\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|c| (beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir).to_path_buf(), c))\n                .collect()\n        };\n\n        if let Some((path, candidate)) = candidates.first() {\n            match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": candidate.id,\n                        \"title\": candidate.title,\n                        \"priority\": candidate.priority,\n                        \"downstream_impact\": candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee,\n                        \"workspace\": path.display().to_string(),\n                        \"dry_run\": true\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    println!(\n                        \"{} (priority={}, impact={}, workspace={})\",\n                        candidate.id,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        path.display()\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        } else if format == \"json\" {\n            println!(\"{{}}\");\n        } else {\n            println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n        }\n    } else if any {\n        // Claim from any workspace\n        let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n            // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n            find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n        } else {\n            workspace_paths.to_vec()\n        };\n\n        let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n                bead_id,\n                reclaimed,\n                workspace_path,\n            }) => match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                        \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee,\n                        \"workspace\": workspace_path.map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    if let Some(path) = workspace_path {\n                        println!(\"{} (workspace: {})\", bead_id, path.display());\n                    } else {\n                        println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                    }\n                }\n            },\n            None => {\n                if format == \"json\" {\n                    println!(\"{{}}\");\n                } else {\n                    println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    } else if fallback == Some(\"any\") {\n        // Fallback mode: try current workspace first, then any\n        let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n        let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n        let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            claim(tx, assignee, claim_ttl, Utc::now(), Some(&worker_metadata))\n        })?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n                bead_id, reclaimed, ..\n            }) => match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                        \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                }\n            },\n            None => {\n                // Fallback to any workspace\n                let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                    find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n                } else {\n                    workspace_paths.to_vec()\n                };\n\n                let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n                match result {\n                    Some(ClaimResult {\n                        bead_id,\n                        reclaimed,\n                        workspace_path,\n                    }) => match format {\n                        \"json\" => {\n                            let output = serde_json::json!({\n                                \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                                \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                                \"assignee\": assignee,\n                                \"workspace\": workspace_path.map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                            });\n                            println!(\"{}\", output);\n                        }\n                        _ => {\n                            if let Some(path) = workspace_path {\n                                println!(\"{} (workspace: {})\", bead_id, path.display());\n                            } else {\n                                println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    },\n                    None => {\n                        if format == \"json\" {\n                            println!(\"{{}}\");\n                        } else {\n                            println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Normal single-workspace claim\n        let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n        let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n        let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            claim(tx, assignee, claim_ttl, Utc::now(), Some(&worker_metadata))\n        })?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n                bead_id, reclaimed, ..\n println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                }\n            },\n            None => {\n                if format == \"json\" {\n                    println!(\"{{}}\");\n                } else {\n                    println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_sync(beads_dir: &PathBuf, flush_only: bool, import_only: bool) -> Result<()> {\n    let workspace_dir = beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir);\n\n    if import_only {\n        let result = crate::sync::import(workspace_dir)?;\n        println!(\"Imported {} beads\", result.imported);\n        if result.updated > 0 {\n            println!(\"Updated {} beads\", result.updated);\n        }\n        if result.skipped > 0 {\n            println!(\"Skipped {} println!(\"Skipped {} unchanged beads\", result.skipped);\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_doctor(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    repair: bool,\n    flush_first: bool,\n    force: bool,\n    reclaim_stale: bool,\n    ttl: Option<i64>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    if repair {\n        let workspace_dir = beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir);\n        let imported = crate::doctor::repair(workspace_dir, flush_first, force)?;\n        println!(\n            \"Repaired database: imported {} beads from JSONL\",\n            imported\n        );\n    } else if reclaim_stale {\n        let workspace_dir = beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir);\n        let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n        let ttl_minutes = ttl.unwrap_or(config.claim_ttl_minutes);\n        let reclaimed = crate::doctor::reclaim_stale(workspace_dir, ttl_minutes)?;\n        println!(\"Reclaimed {} stale bead(s)\", reclaimed);\n    } else {\n        // Run health check\n        let workspace_dir = beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir);\n        let result = crate::doctor::check(workspace_dir)?;\n\n        // Report results\n        if result.db_ok && result.jsonl_ok {\n            println!(\"✓ Database integrity: OK\");\n            println!(\"✓ JSONL validity: OK\");\n            println!(\"  Database beads: {}\", result.db_issue_count);\n            println!(\"  JSONL beads: {}\", result.jsonl_line_count);\n\n            let total_drift = result.missing_in_jsonl.len()\n                + result.missing_in_sqlite.len()\n                + result.hash_mismatch.len();\n\n            if total_drift == 0 {\n                println!(\"✓ Consistency: No drift detected\");\n            } else {\n                println!(\"⚠ Consistency: Drift detected\");\n                if !result.missing_in_jsonl.is_empty() {\n                    println!(\"  Missing in JSONL ({}):\", result.missing_in_jsonl.len());\n                    for id in result.missing_in_jsonl.iter().take(10) {\n                        println!(\"    - {}\", id);\n                    }\n                    if result.missing_in_jsonl.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.missing_in_jsonl.len() - 10);\n                    }\n                }\n                if !result.missing_in_sqlite.is_empty() {\n                    println!(\"  Missing in SQLite ({}):\", result.missing_in_sqlite.len());\n                    for id in result.missing_in_sqlite.iter().take(10) {\n                        println!(\"    - {}\", id);\n                    }\n                    if result.missing_in_sqlite.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.missing_in_sqlite.len() - 10);\n                    }\n                }\n                if !result.hash_mismatch.is_empty() {\n                    println!(\"  Hash mismatch ({}):\", result.hash_mismatch.len());\n                    for id in result.hash_mismatch.iter().take(10) {\n                        println!(\"    - {}\", id);\n                    }\n                    if result.hash_mismatch.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.hash_mismatch.len() - 10);\n                    }\n                }\n                println!();\n                println!(\"Run 'bf doctor --repair' to rebuild SQLite from JSONL\");\n            }\n\n            // Report unflushed beads (if any)\n            if result.unflushed_count > 0 {\n                println!(\"⚠ Unflushed beads: {}\", result.unflushed_count);\n                println!(\"  Run 'bf sync --flush-only' before repair to avoid data loss\");\n            }\n        } else {\n            if !result.db_ok {\n                println!(\"✗ Database integrity: FAILED\");\n            }\n            if !result.jsonl_ok {\n                println!(\"✗ JSONL validity: FAILED\");\n            }\n            for issue in &result.issues {\n                eprintln!(\"  {}\", issue);\n            }\n            if !result.jsonl_ok || !result.db_ok {\n                println!();\n                println!(\"Run 'bf doctor --repair' to rebuild SQLite from JSONL\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_commit_check(beads_dir: &PathBuf) -> Result<()> {\n    let result = scan_staged_beads(beads_dir)?;\n\n    if result.secrets_found.is_empty() {\n        // Clean - no output on success (standard for pre-commit hooks)\n        std::process::exit(0);\n    }\n\n    // Secrets found - print details and exit 1\n    eprintln!(\"{}\", format_scan_results(&result));\n    std::process::exit(1);\n}\n\nfn cmd_count(beads_dir: &PathBuf, status: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path =    };\n\n    println!(\"{}\", count);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_batch(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    file: Option<PathBuf>,\n    json: Option<String>,\n    stdin: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let       eprintln!(\n                \"[op {}] error: {}\",\n                result.op,\n                result.error.unwrap_or_default()\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_mitosis(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    children: &str,\n    reason: &str,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    // Parse children as JSON array of {title, type, priority} or {title, type, priority, description, assignee, labels}\n    let children_defs: Vec<MitosisChild> = serde_json::from_str(children)?;\n\n    // Build the batch operations\n    let ops = mitosis_ex(id, children_defs, Some(reason.to_string()))?;\n\n    // Execute atomically\n    let results = execute_batch(&storage, ops, beads_dir)?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&results)?);\n        }\n        _ => {\n            // Print child IDs that were created\n            for result in &results {\n                if print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: &PathBuf, dep: DepCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match dep {\n        DepCommands::Add {\n            issue,\n            depends_on,\n            type_,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let dep_type =\n                crate::model::DependencyType::from_str(&type_).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            storage.add_dependency(&issue, &depends_on, &dep_type, \"cli\")?;\n            println!(\n                \"Added dependency: {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                issue, depends_on, type_\n            );\n        }\n        DepCommands::Remove { issue, depends_on } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            storage.remove_dependency(&issue, &depends_on)?;\n            println!(\"Removed dependency: {} -> {}\", issue, depends_on);\n        }\n        DepCommands::List { id } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let deps = storage.get_dependencies(&id)?;\n            if deps.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"No dependencies found for {}\", id);\n            } else {\n                for dep in deps {\n                    println!(\n                        \"  {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                        dep.issue_id, dep.depends_on_id, dep.dep_type\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        DepCommands::Tree {\n            id,\n            direction,\n            max_depth,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n\n            // Validate direction\n            let direction = match direction.as_str() {\n                \"down\" | \"up\" | \"both\" => direction.as_str(),\n                _ => {\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Invalid direction: {}. Use 'down', 'up', or 'both'\",\n                        direction\n                    ))\n                }\n            };\n\n            if format == \"json\" {\n                // JSON output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"downward\": down_nodes,\n                        \"upward\": up_nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"nodes\": nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Text output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    // Show both directions separately\n                    println!(\n                        \"Dependency tree for {} (downward - what this depends on):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&down_nodes, &storage)?;\n\n                    if !down_nodes.is_empty() {\n                        println!();\n                    }\n\n                    println!(\n                        \"Reverse dependency tree for {} (upward - what depends on this):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&up_nodes, &storage)?;\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&nodes, &storage)?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_label(beads_dir: &PathBuf, label: LabelCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match label {\n
